item.title: HTB-Cerberus Writeup
item.description: Nmap 探索 使用 nmap 扫描存活的 tcp 端口，只有 8080。 ┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/Work/Kali/Cerberus] └─$ sudo nmap --min-rate 10000 -p- 10.129.232.100 -oA Nmap/ports Starting Nmap 7.98 ( https://nmap.org ) at 2026-11-03 05:30 -0500 Nmap scan report for 10.129.232.100 Host is up (0.73s latency). Not shown: 65534 filtered tcp ports (no-response) PORT STATE SERVICE 8080/tcp open http-proxy Nmap done: 1 IP address (1 host up) scanned in 18.63 seconds Web 渗透 访问 8080 端口，自动跳转至 icinga.cerberus.local，解析 DNS。
